scene: The yellow drone chirps, dispensing warm buttered popcorn into a purple bag.
picture: Side-view pixel art along the rooftop. Left, a closed iron roof hatch lies flat. Left-centre, the yellow drone hovers beside the Pacific Islander girl in her blue windbreaker and cargo shorts, sketchbook underarm, holding a purple popcorn bag at centre. Right, the brass cloud projector gleams. Far right, pink neon roof railings glow.
shown: a steaming purple paper bag of popcorn held at centre
a brass cloud projector angled toward the sky on the right
a bolted metal service hatch set in the floor on the left

variants.scene: Steam rises from the fresh popcorn bag as the little drone hovers nearby.
